recentItems.description:
A tense situation unfolded outside the Nagari Degree College counting centre in Chittoor district during the Parishad election counting. Former minister Roja staged a protest along with the YSRCP candidate, demanding a recount after the Returning Officer declared the TDP candidate the winner in the Illathur MPTC seat by a margin of three votes. The protest led to arguments with police, and the demonstrators were moved away from the counting centre. Watch the latest developments and visuals from Nagari.

recentItems.description:
Indian pacer Gurnoor Brar impressed everyone with a brilliant bowling spell in the second ODI against New Zealand. Brar claimed four crucial wickets, conceding just 30 runs in nearly 10 overs, as India bowled out New Zealand for 134. His key breakthroughs included Tom Latham, Glenn Phillips, Mitchell Santner and Nathan Smith. With two wickets each from Akib Nabi, Anshul Kamboj and Axar Patel, India dominated the New Zealand batting lineup.
